meaning:
ἐπί-βλημα, -τος, τό
[in LXX: Isa.3:22 * ;]
1. that which is thrown over, a cover.
2. a tapestry, hanging (Is, l.with).
3. that which is put on;
(a) embroidery;
(b) a patch: Mat.9:16, Mrk.2:21, Luk.5:36.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.
No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.
He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will…
